name: SalesReceipt
description: A SalesReceipt represents a sales receipt given to a customer where payment is received as part of the sale of goods and services, specifying the deposit account where the customer's payment is deposited (defaulting to the Undeposited Funds account if not specified).

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of a transaction. Valid Line types include: SalesItemLine, GroupLine, DescriptionOnlyLine, DiscountLine and SubTotalLine (read-only). If the transaction is taxable there is a limit of 750 lines per transaction.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the line in the collection.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-form text description of the line item.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line item.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: The type of line detail, e.g. SalesItemLineDetail, SubTotalLineDetail.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the tax code for this item.

fields.name: CustomerRef
fields.description: Reference to a customer or job. Use Customer.Id and Customer.DisplayName for CustomerRef.value and CustomerRef.name, respectively.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification.

fields.name: ShipFromAddr
fields.description: Identifies the address where the goods are shipped from. Conditionally required: required for accurate sales tax calculation when automated sales tax is enabled.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, e.g. state.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the transaction are expressed. Conditionally required: must be defined if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method in which tax is applied. Not applicable to US companies; required for non-US companies.

fields.name: ProjectRef
fields.description: Reference to the Project ID associated with this transaction. Conditionally required.

fields.name: BillEmail
fields.description: Identifies the e-mail address where the receipt is sent. Conditionally required: required if EmailStatus=NeedToSend.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. If not supplied, the current date on the server is used. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: CustomField
fields.description: One of, up to three custom fields for the transaction. Available for custom fields configured for the company.

attributes.name: DefinitionId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the custom field definition.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: Data type of the custom field, e.g. StringType.

attributes.name: StringValue
attributes.description: Value of the custom field when Type is StringType.

fields.name: ShipDate
fields.description: Date for delivery of goods or services.

fields.name: TrackingNum
fields.description: Shipping provider's tracking number for the delivery of the goods associated with the transaction.

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with the transaction. Available if Preferences.AccountingInfoPrefs.ClassTrackingPerTxn is set to true.

fields.name: PrintStatus
fields.description: Printing status of the receipt.

fields.name: PaymentRefNum
fields.description: The reference number for the payment received. For example, Check # for a check, envelope # for a cash donation.

fields.name: TxnSource
fields.description: Used internally to specify originating source of a credit card transaction.

fields.name: LinkedTxn
fields.description: Zero or more related transactions to this sales receipt object. Use LinkedTxn.TxnId as the ID in a separate read request to retrieve details of the linked object.

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: Transaction Id of the related transaction.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: Transaction type of the linked transaction, e.g. Payment, ReimburseCharge, ChargeCredit, StatementCharge, Estimate, refundReceipt.

fields.name: ApplyTaxAfterDiscount
fields.description: If false or null, calculate the sales tax first, then apply the discount. If true, subtract the discount first then calculate sales tax. Default false. US versions of QuickBooks only.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction. If not provided, populated based on Preferences:CustomTxnNumber. Optional for all locales except France.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction. Does not appear on the transaction form to the customer. Maps to the Memo field on the Sales Receipt form.

fields.name: DepositToAccountRef
fields.description: Account to which payment money is deposited (Account.AccountType is Other Current Asset or Bank). If not specified, payment is applied to the Undeposited Funds account.

fields.name: CustomerMemo
fields.description: User-entered message to the customer; visible to the end user on their transactions.

fields.name: EmailStatus
fields.description: Email status of the receipt.

fields.name: CreditCardPayment
fields.description: Information about a credit card payment for the transaction. Used when PaymentType is CreditCard. Inject with data only if the payment was transacted through Intuit Payments API.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Provides information for taxes charged on the transaction as a whole, based on the tax codes referenced by the transaction.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any embedded tax lines.

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction tax code.

fields.name: PaymentMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to a PaymentMethod associated with this transaction. Use PaymentMethod.Id and PaymentMethod.Name for value and name, respectively.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home currency units it takes to equal one unit of currency specified by CurrencyRef. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: ShipAddr
fields.description: Identifies the address where the goods must be shipped. If not specified, the default Customer:ShippingAddr is used.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, e.g. state.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: A reference to a Department object specifying the location of the transaction. Available if Preferences.AccountingInfoPrefs.TrackDepartments is set to true.

fields.name: ShipMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to the ShipMethod associated with the transaction. There is no shipping method list; reference resolves to a string.

fields.name: BillAddr
fields.description: Bill-to address. If not specified, the default Customer:BillingAddr is used.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, e.g. state.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. Set by Data Services and read only for all applications.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated.

fields.name: HomeBalance
fields.description: Convenience field containing the amount in Balance expressed in terms of the home currency. Calculated by QuickBooks. Valid only when CurrencyRef is specified and multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: DeliveryInfo
fields.description: Email delivery information. Returned when a request has been made to deliver email with the send operation.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: A reference to the Recurring Transaction. Captures what recurring transaction template the SalesReceipt was created from.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction, including all charges, allowances, and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks; any value supplied is over-written.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: The balance reflecting any payments made against the transaction. Initially set to the value of TotalAmt. A Balance of 0 indicates fully paid. Calculated by QuickBooks; any value supplied is over-written.

fields.name: HomeTotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the home currency, including all charges, allowances and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks. Valid only when CurrencyRef is specified and multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: FreeFormAddress
fields.description: Denotes how ShipAddr is stored: formatted or unformatted. System defined based on format of shipping address at object create time. If false, returned in a formatted style; if true, returned in an unformatted style using Line1 through Line5.

specialOperations.name: Void a salesreceipt
specialOperations.description: Voids an existing SalesReceipt via a sparse update with include=void, zeroing all amounts and quantities and prepending 'Voided' to PrivateNote.

queryParams.name: operation
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'update' to void the object.

queryParams.name: include
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'void' to void the object.

specialOperations.note: POST sparse update with operation=update&include=void query params; request body requires Id, SyncToken, and sparse=true. If the receipt is paid and funds deposited, delete the associated deposit before voiding.

specialOperations.name: Get a salesreceipt as PDF
specialOperations.description: Returns the specified sales receipt as an Adobe PDF file formatted according to the company's custom form styles.

pathParams.name: salesreceiptId
pathParams.description: The ID of the sales receipt to retrieve as PDF.

specialOperations.note: Returns binary PDF content (application/pdf) rather than JSON.

specialOperations.name: Send a salesreceipt
specialOperations.description: Emails the sales receipt to the customer, setting EmailStatus to EmailSent and populating DeliveryInfo; with sendTo, also updates BillEmail.Address to that address.

queryParams.name: sendTo
queryParams.description: Email address to send the sales receipt to; if specified, updates SalesReceipt.BillEmail.Address to this value.

pathParams.name: salesreceiptId
pathParams.description: The ID of the sales receipt to send.

specialOperations.note: Two variants: implicit send to the stored BillEmail address (no query param), or explicit send via the sendTo query param which also updates BillEmail.Address.
